# 0.4.1 - Warning-free builds

This maintenance release changes no receiver behaviour. It removes the
remaining warnings from the ESP32 build and the Home Assistant checks.

## Highlights

- The ESP32 build no longer emits five `-Wformat` warnings from the startup
  configuration dump. The logged output is unchanged.
- The Home Assistant integration manifest declares its category
  (`media_entertainment.speakers_audio`), which removes the hassfest warning.
- CI runs on `ubuntu-26.04` instead of `ubuntu-24.04`.

## Upgrade Notes

- No option changed; `v0.4.0` configurations keep working. Change the
  `external_components` source to `@v0.4.1`.
